title: Border Warnings (region border banner)
layout_order: one banner, top centre under the toolbar and navigation bar (view top - 72 px, 62% of the view wide, 360-760 px): coloured level bar (left edge) | level word (WARNING / CAUTION / INFO) then the title in white, distance to the border right-aligned | reason line | outcome line (bold) | Teleport button (44 px tall) when a teleport to the far side is on offer. No hit ids: the HUD has one button rectangle (mButton); there is no close button, no hotkey and no resize grip - the banner goes when the state clears.

controls.name: banner-panel
controls.label: dark panel with a coloured level bar; drawn only when a banner level is set
controls.when: Border Warnings on and something ahead / an event
source: const S32 top = view_h - 72;   // under the top toolbar and the navigation bar

controls.name: level-word
controls.label: WARNING (red) / CAUTION (amber) / INFO (teal), coloured word and bar - never colour alone
source: return l == WolfBorder::L_WARNING ? C_RED : l == WolfBorder::L_CAUTION ? C_AMBER : C_TEAL;

controls.name: distance
controls.label: <n> m / <n.n> km to the border, right of the title; remade only when it changes
controls.when: a banner built from the look ahead (not events)

controls.name: state-ahead-region
controls.label: CAUTION - AHEAD: <region> / <why> / You'll be carried across to <to>. | You'll be carried over it (to <to>). | You can't walk in. (You can teleport across to <to> instead.) | Your vehicle will stop at the border. / You can't go in.
controls.when: Wolf Territories region with WolfBorderModule, a fresh look that is not ok/clear
source: b.mOutcome = "You'll be carried across to " + to + ".";
b.mOutcome = to.empty() ? std::string("You'll be carried over it.") : "You'll be carried over it to " + to + ".";
b.mOutcome += " You can teleport across to " + to + " instead.";
b.mOutcome = root ? "Your vehicle will stop at the border." : "You can't go in.";

controls.name: state-refused-lately
controls.label: CAUTION - AHEAD: <region> / It refused you a few minutes ago. / Your vehicle will stop at the border. | You can't walk in.
controls.when: off the module: heading for a region that refused us lately
source: b.mReason = "It refused you a few minutes ago.";

controls.name: state-scripts-off
controls.label: CAUTION - AHEAD: <region> / Scripts are switched off in that region. / Your vehicle would stop working there.
controls.when: off the module, seated, region ahead has REGION_FLAGS_SKIP_SCRIPTS
source: b.mReason = "Scripts are switched off in that region.";
b.mOutcome = "Your vehicle would stop working there.";

controls.name: event-held
controls.label: WARNING - STOPPED AT THE BORDER: <ahead> / <why> / Asking the region to carry you across to <to>... | Your vehicle is held here. Turn back, or find another way round. (8 s)
source: "Asking the region to carry you across to " + mLook.mTo + "..." : "Your vehicle is held here. Turn back, or find another way round."

controls.name: event-hop
controls.label: INFO - CARRIED ACROSS: <ahead> / <why> / Coming out in <to>. (8 s)

controls.name: event-hopfail
controls.label: CAUTION - CANNOT CARRY YOU ACROSS(: <ahead>) / <why> / Your vehicle will stop at the border. (6 s)
source: b.mTitle = ahead.empty() ? std::string("CANNOT CARRY YOU ACROSS") : "CANNOT CARRY YOU ACROSS: " + ahead;

controls.name: event-not-allowed
controls.label: WARNING - NOT ALLOWED IN: <region> / <refusal alert> / Your vehicle stopped at the border. Turn back, or find another way round. | You can't walk in. You can teleport to the far side instead. | You can't walk in. (12 s)
source: b.mOutcome = "Your vehicle stopped at the border. Turn back, or find another way round.";
b.mOutcome = "You can't walk in. You can teleport to the far side instead.";

controls.name: event-stopped-off-grid
controls.label: WARNING - STOPPED AT THE BORDER: <region> / The region did not take your vehicle. / Turn back, or find another way round. (8 s)
controls.when: off the module: a vehicle that drove up to the edge and stopped dead
source: s.mReason = "The region did not take your vehicle.";
s.mOutcome = "Turn back, or find another way round.";

controls.label: Teleport across to <region> / Teleport to the far side
controls.when: a walker refused, with a far side on offer (mOfferTeleport)
controls.tip: An ordinary teleport: the region you land in checks it like any other.
source: b.mTeleportLabel = far_name.empty() ? std::string("Teleport to the far side") : "Teleport across to " + far_name;
const S32 button_h = 44;   // a 44 px target (Fitts / WCAG 2.5.5)
"An ordinary teleport: the region you land in checks it like any other."

controls.name: teleport-refused
controls.label: nearby chat: Not teleported: the far side the region gave is too far from where you are now.
controls.when: Teleport pressed after the walker moved out of range
source: "Not teleported: the far side the region gave is too far from where you are now."

controls.name: announce
controls.label: each new banner said once to nearby chat (title - reason outcome), and spoken by the Tower Voice on Wolf Territories; not again within ANNOUNCE_AGAIN_S

controls.name: click-through
controls.label: only the Teleport button takes clicks; the world under the panel keeps them
source: return false;   // the world under the panel keeps its clicks

controls.name: menu-warnings
controls.label: Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Border Warnings (check, setting WolfBorderWarnings)

controls.name: menu-hop
controls.label: Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Carry My Vehicle Across Refusing Regions (check, setting WolfBorderHop)
source: <menu_item_check label="Carry My Vehicle Across Refusing Regions" name="WolfBorderHop">

controls.name: menu-teleport
controls.label: Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Teleport Across the Border Ahead (the banner's button from the keyboard); commit WolfBorder.TeleportAcross, enabled by WolfBorder.CanTeleportAcross
controls.when: enabled while a teleport is on offer
source: <menu_item_call label="Teleport Across the Border Ahead" name="WolfBorderTeleport">
